title: Waiting to travel
passage: A. Travelers are lifting luggage onto an aircraft. B. Some travelers are waiting beside their luggage. C. All the seats are being removed from the terminal. D. A suitcase is being repaired on a workbench.
passageZh:
A. 旅客正把行李搬上飛機。
B. 一些旅客正在行李旁等候。
C. 航廈內所有座椅都正在被搬走。
D. 一個行李箱正在工作檯上維修。
